yyjson

Source: https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson
Version: 0.12.0
Commit: 7871d321ff4cd8068c1f777c97975dc2fb640ab3
License: MIT (see LICENSE)

The unmodified src/yyjson.c and src/yyjson.h implement strict UTF-8 JSON parsing
for the BlastEM control protocol v2 (ctrl_v2.c). No system JSON library is required.
